description: Starts a sheet-metal part from a sketch: a closed profile becomes a flat tab thickness_mm thick; an open chain is extruded depth_mm and each of its sharp corners becomes a bend of bend_radius_mm (inner radius). The allowance becomes the part's default (K-factor 0.5 when absent), and the relief its automatic relief. One sheet-metal body per part: a part that already has one is refused, because thickness belongs to the part and a second body would change the first. Lengths in mm, angles in degrees. Checked: the part is sheet metal with one sheet body, Sheet-Metal and Flat-Pattern exist, the thickness reads back and measures between the sheet's two faces, the radius and allowance read back; a closed profile adds exactly its area times the thickness, and an open chain of lines its straight legs plus each bend's material, with a bend at each corner. Otherwise everything it made is deleted and the part is as it was (rolled back); the sketch stays. Busy with user_editing while the user is editing a sketch or has a command open. References are opaque: pass one back exactly as it was given, and never build or change one.

document.description: The part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

sketch.description: The sketch: its name (Sketch1) or reference. A closed profile, or one open chain whose lines are one face of the sheet.

thickness_mm.description: The sheet's thickness, mm, more than 0.

bend_radius_mm.description: The default inner bend radius, mm, more than 0: the bends at an open chain's corners, and later bends that do not give their own.

k_factor.description: The K-factor: where the neutral layer sits across the thickness, more than 0 and at most 1 (0.5 is the middle). The bend develops to angle × (inner radius + K × thickness).

allowance_mm.description: The bend allowance itself, mm, more than 0: the length the bend develops to, whatever its angle.

deduction_mm.description: The bend deduction, mm, 0 or more: what the bend takes off the sum of the two flanges' outer lengths to the virtual sharp.

allowance.description: The part's default bend allowance: exactly one of k_factor, allowance_mm or deduction_mm. Default k_factor 0.5.

reverse.description: Thicken to the other side of the sketch. Default false.

depth_mm.description: For an open chain only: how far it is extruded, mm, more than 0, along the sketch's normal.

relief.description: The automatic relief where a bend meets material that does not bend: rectangular (the default), obround or tear.

relief_ratio.description: The relief's size as a ratio of the thickness, at least 0.05 and at most 2. Default 0.5.
